algorithm.decodedFrames: complete deterministic RGB decode; governing loop endpoints are physical n=0 and n=frameCount-1

sourceSampleContract.first: physical frame n=0 at its ffprobe best-effort presentation timestamp
sourceSampleContract.last: physical frame n=frameCount-1 at its ffprobe best-effort presentation timestamp

algorithm.normalization: center-crop Reference to decoded loop aspect; resize loop and Reference to 256x256 Lanczos RGB
algorithm.ssim: 11x11 valid-window BT.709-luma SSIM; K1=0.01, K2=0.03, L=255
algorithm.hashes: 64-bit bilinear aHash, dHash, and 32x32 DCT pHash

thresholdCalibration.corpus: all physical first/last frames of the 75 Reference loops required by the declared Vibes transition graph, each compared with its declared still and all 74 wrong stills
thresholdCalibration.purpose: prove bounded semantic visual identity after authored depth, crop, grading, and particle treatment; do not claim pixel identity
thresholdCalibration.absoluteFloor: SSIM, pHash, edge, RMSE, histogram, hash, and weighted semantic-similarity floors must all pass
thresholdCalibration.retrievalMargin: the declared still must rank first without a negative margin among candidates that pass the retrieval absolute floor; ranking still evaluates the complete required-Reference corpus

algorithm.decision: the loop terminal certifies semantic visual identity only when its absolute floor and all-Reference retrieval-margin checks pass; both terminals certify the anchor
algorithm.truthBoundary: certified means the displayed adaptive loop retains the Reference still's semantic visual identity; it does not mean pixel identity with the clean still or transition endpoint

tooling.ffprobe: ffprobe version 8.1.1 Copyright (c) 2007-2026 the FFmpeg developers

strictPixelIdentityDiagnostic.truthBoundary: reported to prevent semantic loop identity from being mistaken for clean-still pixel identity

consumerContract.selectionGate: a compiler may select an A/B Reference loop only when its exact cardId record exists, decision is certified, selectionEligibility is true, and all input/result digests revalidate
consumerContract.continuityClaim: this receipt proves bounded semantic visual identity between each adaptive loop terminal and its declared Reference still; transition-terminal pixel identity remains a separate receipt
consumerContract.transitiveUse: A-loop -> declared A still -> certified transition terminal is a lineage-plus-semantic bridge, not a claim that A-loop and transition terminal pixels are identical
